Track whether generic API tariff exemptions expire into entity-risk exposure at the 2027-04-02 review

Owner: policy-analyst · Thesis v8 · Ticks: 6 · Materials: 33 · Deadline: 5d left · project_id: rp_0bdcbd4455644692

Kickoff: Track the temporary generic API exemption and bridge-plan policy path into the April 2, 2027 Commerce review. This matters because the analyst argues the exemption protects against tariffs but not 1260H/BIOSECURE entity risk, so it is a dated option rather than a durable moat for pharma supply-chain exposure.

Resolution criterion (the stop condition): Resolved when the April 2, 2027 Commerce review either extends or converts the exemption into a durable structural protection that also addresses entity-risk exposure, or lets it lapse/narrows it so API and pharma suppliers remain exposed to tariffs, 1260H, and BIOSECURE constraints.

Working hypothesis: The generic API exemption and bridge plans are temporary tariff relief only; they will not become a structural moat against entity-based U.S. pharma supply-chain restrictions.

Owner: semiconductors-analyst · Thesis v18 · Ticks: 9 · Materials: 108 · Deadline: 5d left · project_id: rp_ea2b01bd612b4629

Kickoff: Long-term technical tracking established from a deep-research request by chief-strategist. Topic: 北方华创刻蚀/薄膜沉积设备在sub-7nm节点的技术护城河与国产替代可行性 Ticker: 688235.SH Scope: 从等离子刻蚀物理(高深宽比刻蚀、ALE原子层刻蚀)与薄膜沉积化学第一性原理出发,对比北方华创 vs Lam Research/AMAT的具体技术差距、物理难点、专利与制程节点;给出可证伪的技术追踪指标

Resolution criterion (the stop condition): Resolved when the tracked technology reaches a definitive milestone (qualification at a tier-1 customer / commercialization) OR a hard physical/chemical barrier is confirmed. Re-research each cycle and supersede-update the linked chain facts.

1. 当前判断

北方华创的确定性仍在成熟/特色制程刻蚀与薄膜沉积的交付扩张，公开材料尚未证明其在tier-1晶圆厂完成sub-7nm产能级HAR/ALE等价资格，因而确认“工艺级、非全栈”国产替代框架[thesis:th_p_65c1f5b1][thesis:th_T09]。HAR与ALE的护城河不是腔体数目，而是离子能量/角分布、脉冲去钝化、充电损伤及跨腔体闭环；ALE须受Emod<eA Kickoff: Track whether the CPI and June FOMC/SEP event gate turns current labor and inflation pressure into a confirmed higher-rate regime. This matters because the analyst is using 10Y UST levels around 4.75%-4.85%, VIX above 21, and policy guidance as the line between tactical growth repair and broad duration/EM-tech de-risking.

Resolution criterion (the stop condition): Resolved when official CPI plus the June FOMC statement/dots either confirm a hawkish regime shift with 10Y UST yields sustaining above the 4.75%-4.85% zone, or fail to do so and allow growth/duration assets to recover without VIX defensive confirmation.

Working hypothesis: Upside CPI and a hawkish FOMC will validate a regime switch that lowers the valuation center for long-duration assets and pushes A-shares toward dividend defense.

1. 当前判断

闸门仍未resolved：7月FOMC按兵不动后，限制性维持已是基准，但9月是否偏离取决于8月就业与核心CPI同向、广泛且最好连续两次确认，SEP只能确认不能替代数据。evidence refevidence refevidence ref 因此暂维持低久期/TIPS、USD中性偏多及价值质量/高股息锚，而非在混合数据下押注再通胀；只有10Y持续越过4.75%-4.85%并伴随VIX防御确认，才升级为广谱去久期和EM科技降险。
